
'''Takasago Shrine''' (高砂神社) is a [[Shinto shrine]].

* [[Takasago Shrine (Sendai)]] – Located in [[Miyagi Prefecture]], [[Sendai]], [[Miyagino-ku, Sendai|Miyagino-ku]].
* [[Takasago Shrine (Adachi)]] – Located in [[Tokyo|Tokyo Metropolis]], [[Adachi, Tokyo]], [[Adachi]].
* [[Takasago Shrine (Osaka)]] – Located in [[Osaka Prefecture]], [[Osaka]], [[Suminoe-ku, Osaka|Suminoe-ku]].
* [[Takasago Shrine]] – Located in [[Hyōgo Prefecture]], [[Takasago, Hyōgo]].
